title: main.hub logbook entry
description: One line of logbook.jsonl. Keyed on `kind`, following this workspace's doc-ecosystem logbook convention (a KINDS / REQUIRED_BY_KIND table shared by other repositories in the same programme). Every kind requires ts, kind and what; each kind then adds the fields that make its own claim checkable. `scripts/hub.py check` re-implements these same rules by hand (no external schema-validator dependency, consistent with the rest of the file's hand-written graph validation) and validates every real line of logbook.jsonl against them.

ts.description: DISCREPANCY (noted, not force-fit): the doc-ecosystem checker (check_logbook.mjs) requires full ISO 8601 with a time and a timezone offset. Every line actually written in this repository's own logbook.jsonl (all 41 entries, 2026-09-18 and 2026-09-20) uses a bare calendar date instead. This schema validates the file as it REALLY is, not the stricter convention; a future session that wants full timestamps should change the data and this pattern together, not just one of them.

by.description: Who made the decision. Only decision entries carry this field in the real file.

observe.description: Noticed something, not measured yet. No extra required fields beyond ts/kind/what -- matches every observe line actually in logbook.jsonl (6 entries, e.g. lines 5, 16, 30, 32).

measure.description: Got a number -- needs value + unit. Not yet used in this repository's logbook.jsonl (0 entries as of 2026-09-20); kept because it is a known kind of the doc-ecosystem convention this file otherwise follows.

attempt.description: Tried something, outcome not yet known. No extra required fields. Not yet used in this repository's logbook.jsonl (0 entries as of 2026-09-20); kept because it is a known kind of the doc-ecosystem convention.

hypothesis.description: A claim taken in to be tested -- needs a falsifier and a source. Matches the one hypothesis line in logbook.jsonl (line 19).

decision.description: Chose one path over others -- needs id, by, why and alternatives (alternatives is mandatory per this workspace's own doc-ecosystem discipline: a choice with no alternatives recorded was not a choice). `alternatives` may be an empty array (real example: line 34, D19) -- the field must be PRESENT, its contents may legitimately be empty when nothing else was on the table. `outcome` is an optional extra some decisions carry inline (real example: line 41, D22) instead of, or in addition to, a separate negative_result/positive_result line.

negative_result.description: It did not work -- needs outcome. `result_of` (pointing back at a decision id) is the normal case (9 of 10 real entries carry it) but is NOT required by the doc-ecosystem convention and one real entry (line 31, following D21's review) omits it -- this schema follows the real file and the real convention over the task brief that first proposed result_of as mandatory for this kind.

positive_result.description: It worked -- needs outcome. `result_of` is optional, same reasoning as negative_result. Not yet used in this repository's logbook.jsonl (0 entries as of 2026-09-20); kept because it is a known kind of the doc-ecosystem convention.

correction.description: An earlier entry was wrong -- needs corrects. Matches the one correction line in logbook.jsonl (line 23, correcting a commit message, not another logbook line -- `corrects` is free text here, not necessarily a logbook id).

lesson.description: Behaviour must change -- needs becomes_rule. Matches the one lesson line in logbook.jsonl (line 8).
